mechanism: Dexamethasone induces CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, reducing chlorpromazine metabolism and increasing its levels; chlorpromazine may also impair dexamethasone efficacy and increase CNS depression risk.
action: Monitor for increased chlorpromazine toxicity (extrapyramidal symptoms, sedation); consider chlorpromazine dose adjustment or alternative antipsychotic; assess steroid efficacy.
